card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long multi-digit number, such as a patient count or other large figure. It is usually the second- or third-last digit, with more digits following.

modes.label: Trial subject counts
modes.description: A middle digit in a large patient or subject count in clinical trial results.

modes.description: A middle digit in a disk size, zip code, download count or journal volume number.
